videos.scopeEn: Related background for Directed self-assembly patterning. Identify the optics, stages and integration scale of an exposure system; the animation is a tour, not assembly drawings. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 找出光罩與晶圓所處的不同位置。
觀察光學系統與精密運動系統如何配合。
把解析度能力與層間對準能力分開記錄。
watchForEn: Locate the distinct positions of mask and wafer.
Observe cooperation between optics and precision motion.
Record resolution capability separately from layer-to-layer alignment.
videos.before: 先問：「分開區塊相分離與宏觀混合」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Distinguish microphase separation from macroscopic mixing requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「將位錯、橋接與缺失線分開」列為查證任務：不同缺陷代表不同失敗機制。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Separate dislocations, bridges and missing lines: Different defect classes indicate different failure mechanisms. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

guides.title: 導向自組裝圖案化：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Directed self-assembly patterning: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「分開區塊相分離與宏觀混合」建立判讀邊界。共價連接限制兩區塊完全分離。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Distinguish microphase separation from macroscopic mixing to define the interpretation boundary. Covalent linkage prevents complete block separation. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分開區塊相分離與宏觀混合：共價連接限制兩區塊完全分離。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜將位錯、橋接與缺失線分開：不同缺陷代表不同失敗機制。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜提交模板、材料與缺陷證據鏈：可整合性需要位置、缺陷與轉移共同證據。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Distinguish microphase separation from macroscopic mixing: Covalent linkage prevents complete block separation. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Separate dislocations, bridges and missing lines: Different defect classes indicate different failure mechanisms. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a guide–material–defect evidence chain: Integrability needs combined placement, defect and transfer evidence. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「將位錯、橋接與缺失線分開」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「提交模板、材料與缺陷證據鏈」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Separate dislocations, bridges and missing lines: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a guide–material–defect evidence chain to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「自組裝完全不需要任何定位模板。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「單張顯微照片足以證明零缺陷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Self-assembly needs no placement template.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "One micrograph proves zero defects.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.summary: 導向自組裝圖案化涉及跨國材料、設備與量測合作。本課程地圖選用imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）作為公開研究或設備技術的代表位置。課程練習以公開原理連結圖形、材料與驗證，不宣稱此處為唯一發明地、所有技術的生產工廠或實際機台位置。
courses.summaryEn: Directed self-assembly patterning involves international collaboration in materials, equipment and metrology. The map uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research or equipment-technology reference. Exercises connect patterns, materials and validation through public principles; this is not claimed to be the sole invention site, a factory producing every technology, or an instrument location.

history.title: imec 在魯汶成立
history.text: 官方總部沿革將魯汶列為 1984 年發展的起點。
history.textEn: The official headquarters history identifies Leuven as the 1984 starting point.

history.title: 公開混合圖案化整合案例
history.text: imec 說明 SAQP 與 EUV 阻擋圖案化如何共同服務金屬層整合。這是產業研發沿革，不表示本課程全部技術於當年或此地發明。
history.textEn: imec described combining SAQP and EUV block patterning for metal-layer integration. This is research history, not a claim that every course technology was invented there or then.

courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，逐項追蹤材料、圖案形成方式、誤差與驗收證據的差異；相似原理不表示配方可直接移植。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related courses by materials, pattern formation, errors and acceptance evidence. Similar principles do not make recipes directly transferable.
